aspect: Capacity spent on overhead is not spent on the job
description: PSY-001's continuous computation, PSY-003's impression management and OCC-002's pain all draw on the same finite daily budget as the work itself.

aspect: Growth requires slack he does not have
description: Learning a new skill, taking a course, taking a risk on a better job - each needs spare capacity and a stable horizon, and PSY-002 removed the horizon.
energy_note: No spare capacity in which to become better paid.

aspect: The measured version exists in the construction data
description: OCC-002's Texas study found more pain sites produced more severe productivity loss, worst among those sleeping under six hours - so at least one link in this chain is quantified rather than asserted.
energy_note: One link of it is actually measured.

aspect: It compounds over a working life
description: Twenty years of slightly reduced capacity and foreclosed opportunity is not a bad year; it is a different career and a different pension.
energy_note: Not a bad year. A different life.

description: Each foreclosed opportunity removes the platform for the next one, so the gap against an identical man without these hurdles widens every year rather than staying constant.
energy_note: The gap grows every year by itself.

description: They offer it to Danny, who has been there two years. He has been there nine. Nobody says anything about papers and nobody needs to - the role requires signing for deliveries, and signing requires being a person the company can put on a form.
energy_note: Nine years, and it goes to the man who can be put on a form.
